blocks.html: Leading this momentous event were Robinsons Land’s dynamic team headed by (L-R) Arlene Magtibay, RLC’s Senior Vice-President and Gen. Manager for Commercial Centers Division; Faraday Go, RLC’s Executive Vice-President; Frederick Go, RLC’s President and CEO; Hon. Azucena Huervas, Mayor of Valencia City; and Hon. Glenn Galario, Vice-Mayor of Valencia City; Robina Gokongwei-Pe, Robinsons Retail Holdings Inc. President and CEO; and Silvia Celeste Cortesi, Miss Earth Philippines 2018.

Leading property developer, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), has finally opened its 51st mall and its 7th in Mindanao – Robinsons Place Valencia – which further expands its portfolio and strengthens its presence in the region.
Located in Barangay Bagontaas, Robinsons Place Valencia is the newest landmark along the busy Sayre Highway as it flaunts an eye-catching three-story structure inspired by Bukidnon’s favored crops, the pineapple. Designed by the architecture firm Lichauco Guilas + Villanueva (LG+V), which is also responsible for the designs of Robinsons Place Naga and Robinsons North Tacloban, Robinsons Place Valencia has many delights in store for the mallgoers which feature organically designed walls displaying inspiring quotes.
The opening of Robinsons Place Valencia comes with a variety of national and global brands in retail along with the successful chains of Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Applicances, Handyman, and Daiso Japan among others. The mall also houses Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center where the public can process government-related processes more conveniently.
The Food Gallery located on the third level of the mall offers a bigger selection of dishes that can easily satisfy every discerning palate. An added feature on the same level is the Skypark where shoppers can enjoy the breathtaking view of the Pantaron Mountain Range and capture the awesome sight of the golden rice fields during harvest season.
Robinsons Movieworld completes the public’s malling experience as it houses six cinemas including one dedicated to 3D films boasting a total of more than 1,200 seats. Finally, one of Robinsons Place Valencia’s newest attraction is the Koi pond where mall patrons can have a more relaxed and pleasurable shopping and dining experience.
